measurement: RDS EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS), SQL execution milliseconds, read-only fixed queries
protocol: For each scope: old, new, new, old, followed by same-statement EXCEPT ALL comparison. Existing database cache state was not reset. Connection/HTTP/render time excluded.
decision: Reuse existing indexed source reads; no new aggregate table for already-cheap directory/base work. Existing player/archive/home projections remain separate from source facts and official standings.
